'# El código siguiente, que crea un dataframe y quita las filas duplicadas, siempre se ejecuta y actúa como un preámbulo del script: 

# dataset <- data.frame(Country, Revenue, Average Order Value)
# dataset <- unique(dataset)

# Pegue o escriba aquí el código de script:

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# One point per country: the centre of its largest piece of land.
# The centre of all its land together falls in the sea for countries with
# distant territories (France with French Guiana, Norway with Svalbard...).
# adm0_a3 is used because iso_a3 is missing (-99) for France and Norway.
centroids <- world %>%
  select(iso3 = adm0_a3) %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") %>%
  st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
  mutate(area = st_area(geometry)) %>%
  group_by(iso3) %>%
  slice_max(area, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_centroid()

coords <- st_coordinates(centroids)
centroids <- tibble::tibble(iso3 = centroids$iso3,
                            long = coords[, "X"], lat = coords[, "Y"])

# Country names in the data -> ISO codes, so "USA" and "Korea" match
plot_data <- dataset %>%
  rename(AOV = `Average Order Value`) %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode::countrycode(Country, "country.name", "iso3c",
                                         warn = FALSE)) %>%
  inner_join(centroids, by = "iso3") %>%
  arrange(desc(Revenue))   # big bubbles first, small ones drawn on top

# Countries that could not be placed are listed, not hidden
not_mapped <- setdiff(dataset$Country, plot_data$Country)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey92", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data,
             aes(long, lat, size = Revenue, fill = AOV),
             shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 22, name = "Net revenue",
                  limits = c(0, 650000),
                  breaks = c(50000, 200000, 500000),
                  labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "£", big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#9ECAE1", high = "#08306B", name = "Avg order value",
                      limits = c(0, 3000), oob = scales::squish,
                      breaks = c(500, 1500, 2500),
                      labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "£", big.mark = ",")) +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(order = 1, title.position = "top",
                        override.aes = list(fill = "grey60")),
    fill = guide_colourbar(order = 2, title.position = "top",
                           barwidth = unit(12, "cm"), barheight = unit(0.6, "cm"))
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-130, 155), ylim = c(-45, 72), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(caption = if (length(not_mapped) > 0)
         paste("Not shown (no single location):", paste(not_mapped, collapse = ", "))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 26) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.spacing.x = unit(2, "cm"),
        plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 18))'
'Net revenue and average order value by country'
'Bubble size = net revenue · colour = average order value (darker = larger orders)'
